vault_mismatch_desc: Emebere nkwado a site na iji igodo nzuzo dị iche. A ga-ebubata ihe ndetu otu ha dị — ị nwere ike itinye paswọọdụ mbụ iji gụọ ha.
guide_notes_p1: Họrọ ederede ọ bụla iji tinye Bold ma ọ bụ Italic site na toolbar na-ese n'elu — ị nwere ike ijikọ ha abụọ n'otu mkpụrụ okwu.
guide_notes_p2: Tinye foto site na gallery ma ọ bụ igwe foto gị ozugbo n'ime ihe ndetu; a na-echekwa ihe oyiyi n'ime mpaghara ma na-anọ n'okpuru nzuzo.
guide_notes_p3: Pinye ihe ndetu iji dowe ya n'elu ndepụta gị — pịa menu ⋮ ma ọ bụ pịa kaadị ahụ ogologo iji pinye ma ọ bụ wepụ nkwụnye.
guide_checklist_p1: Pịa igbe akara iji gosi na emeela ihe; pịa akara sort iji gbanwee n'etiti: Ndị fọrọ afọ tupu, Ndị mecharala tupu, ma ọ bụ usoro A→Z.
guide_checklist_p2: Zife n'aka ekpe n'elu ahịrị iji hichapụ ya ozugbo. Siffar kọmpat na-egosi ihe ọ bụla n'otu ahịrị.
guide_checklist_p3: Kaadị ihe ndetu na-egosi ngụkọta ọnụ ọgụgụ ihe na ole mecharala — nlele ngwa ngwa nke ọganihu na-enweghị imeghe ihe ndetu.
guide_itinerary_p1: Ntinye ebe ọ bụla na-ejide aha ebe, oge mbata, oge ọpụpụ, na ebe ndetu maka ntinye akwụkwọ ma ọ bụ ntuziaka.
guide_itinerary_p2: Pịa akara ụbọchị ma ọ bụ oge na ntinye ọ bụla iji meghee cuftirgal na iji gbanwee oge — ntinye na-anọ n'usoro oge site na atomatik.
guide_itinerary_p3: Kaadị ihe ndetu na-egosi ngụkọta ebe mgbaba ka ị nwee ike ịhụ usoro njem gị fọrọ nke nta na nlele anya otu ugboro.
guide_meal_plan_p1: Ahịrị ụbọchị ọ bụla nwere ohere maka Nri ụtụtụ, Nri ehihie, Nri abalị, na Ihe nri dị iche iche — hapụ ohere ọ bụla reras ma ọ bụ wepụ ya ma ọ bụrụ na achọghị. Ọzọ ahịrị dị ka a chọrọ.
guide_meal_plan_p2: Pịa ohere nri iji dee aha nri ma ọ bụ tinye gajerun ndetu dị ka ncheta nkwadebe; mgbanwe na-echekwa onwe ya.
guide_meal_plan_p3: Kaadị ihe ndetu na-egosi ụbọchị ole emebere, na-enye nkọwa dị mkpirikpi nke take na-enweghị imeghe ihe ndetu zuru ezu.
guide_recipe_p1: Saita oge nkwadebe, oge nri, na yawan mutane n'elu — yawan mutane na-apụta na kaadị ihe ndetu maka nlele anya sauri.
guide_recipe_p2: Ọzọ ihe nri nwere aha na ole; dọrọ handle nke ahịrị ọ bụla maka reorder na-enweghị gogewa ma ọ bụ sake ọzọ.
guide_recipe_p3: Matakai na-enweta lamba site na atomatik — fanye mataki n'ime ohere ọ bụla na ndepụta ma lambobin na-asabunta onwe ha.
guide_drawing_p1: Họrọ Pen, Highlighter, ma ọ bụ Eraser site na toolbar ala; mezie kalar zane na kaurinsa tupu ịmalite zane.
guide_drawing_p2: Soke ma ọ bụ sake weghachi stroke ọ bụla iche iche site na buttons ↩ / ↪ — jide button ọ bụla iji gaa ngwa ngwa n'akụkọ ihe osise.
guide_drawing_p3: Pịa fito da hoto n'ime toolbar iji chekwara ihe osise gị na gallery ngwaọrụ dị ka full-resolution PNG.
guide_security_p1: Duk ihe ndetu na ihe osise na-anọ n'okpuru nzuzo AES-256 site na iji igodo ewepụtara n'aka asalin password gị — agaghị agụta ya in gụghị ya.
guide_security_p2: Bayan imeghe nke mbụ nke ọma, meghee biometrics n'okpuru Settings maka ohere ngwa ngwa site na akara mkpịsị aka ma ọ bụ Face ID.
guide_security_p3: Akara akwụkwọ ndụ akwụkwọ ndụ 🔒 na kaadị ihe ndetu pụtara na echekwara ya na asalin password jooni. Akara orange pụtara na echekwara ya na password ọzọ — tinye asalin password iji gụọ ya.
guide_sync_p1: Banye na Google n'okpuru Settings → Account; pịa Upload ma ọ bụ Restore maka turawa ma ọ bụ janyowa — jiri account guda 1 na ngwaọrụ kọrọ.
guide_sync_p2: Caggal re-install, banye na pịa Restore from Drive — ngwa a na-eweta gishirin tsaronku ka ihe ndetu niile meghee daidai.
guide_sync_p3: Lokacin na emere gyara na ihe ndetu guda na ngwaọrụ abụọ, ana-egosi alamar nsogbu ka ị zaɓi Keep Local, Keep Remote, ma ọ bụ Keep Both.
guide_controls_p1: Pịa kaadị ihe ndetu iji meghee ya; jide kaadị ọ bụla ogologo iji banye na usoro ịhọrọ ihe dị iche iche — sannan pịa kaadị ndị ọzọ iji tinye na nhọrọ.
guide_controls_p2: Zife kaadị n'aka ekpe iji hichapụ ya. N'ime ihe ndetu, pịa ⋮ iji pinye, gbanwee agba, gbanwee ngalaba, tinye foto, ma ọ bụ hichapụ ihe ndetu.
guide_controls_p3: Pịa akara anya 👁 na kaadị ihe ndetu iji hụ ya tupu imeghe edita — bara uru maka ịgụ ngwa ngwa na-enweghị ịhapụ ndepụta.
guide_organisation_p1: Pịa akara ọchụchọ 🔍 na bar elu iji chọọ n'ụdị ihe ndetu niile — nsonaazụ na-ejikọta isiokwu, ederede, ihe ndepụta, mazaunai, nri, na ihe nri niile otu oge.
guide_organisation_p2: Pịa akara sort iji gbanwee n'etiti: Ndị ọhụrụ tukunna, Ndị ochie tukunna, ma ọ bụ siffar rọba — n'ime siffar rọba kowane rọba (Na kowa, Aiki, Na sirri, Tunanin aiki) nwere ike collapsed.
guide_organisation_p3: Sanya rọba n'elu ihe ndetu ọ bụla na edita site na ahịrị kwakwalwa ala isiokwu; sanya agba na ⋮ → Gbanwee Agba iji mata ihe ndetu iche iche na nlele anya otu ugboro.
faq_lock_icon_q: Me yasa bayani na na-egosi alamar orange na ozi password dị iche?
faq_lock_icon_a: Alamar orange pụtara na ihe ndetu echekwara na asalin password dị iche na nke na-arụ ọrụ jooni. Nke a na-eme mgbe emechara re-install ngwa ma mepụta password ọhụrụ. Tinye asalin password emejiri mgbe emepụtara ihe ndetu maka ohere ịbanye.
faq_forgot_password_q: Me zai faru idan na manta asalin password nke sirri?
faq_forgot_password_a: Ihe ndetu zuru ezu nwere kariya site na end-to-end na AES-256 na password enweghị onye nwere ike ịdawo na ya — gụnyere edita. Idan ị nwere amintaccen backup na Google Drive emere mgbe ị nwere password, maido na ya ma tinye password ahụ. In gụghị asalin password, ihe ndetu nzuzo agaghị emeghe. Emere nke a iji chebe sirrin ku.
faq_sync_devices_q: Yaya zan daidaita bayanai na ngwaọrụ dị iche iche?
faq_sync_devices_a: Je na Settings → Account ma banye na account Google guda 1 na ngwaọrụ kọrọ. Pịa Sync Now maka loda bayanai ma ọ bụ saukarwa. Caggal re-install na ngwaọrụ ọhụrụ, banye tupu sannan pịa Restore site na Drive — ngwa a zai kawo gishirin tsaronku yadda password gị nwere ike imeghe ihe niile daidai.
faq_notes_missing_q: Me yasa bayani na sirri na-apụtaghị mgbe emechara re-install?
faq_notes_missing_a: Ihe ndetu mpaghara na-echekwa n'ime ngwaọrụ gị ma na-agoge ha mgbe ị wepụrụ ngwa ahụ. Idan an sanya Drive sync, banye ọzọ n'okpuru Settings → Account ma pịa Restore site na Drive. Idan mupụtara nkwado JSON site na Settings → Storage → Download Notes JSON, pịa Upload Notes JSON iji weghachi ya.
faq_no_account_q: Zan iya amfani na NoteLiha in gụghị account?
faq_no_account_a: Eeh — ụdị ihe ndetu isii niile (Note, Checklist, Itinerary, Meal Plan, Recipe, Drawing) na-arụ ọrụ offline in gụghị account toraade. A na-adana ha ma na-enweta kariya n'ime ngwaọrụ. Ana buƙatar account naanị ma ọ bụrụ na ị chọrọ Google Drive sync ma ọ bụ cross-device backup.
faq_export_backup_q: Yaya zan mupụta ma ọ bụ backup ihe ndetu gị?
faq_export_backup_a: Wannan tsarin dị jooni tan maka Google Synced Users ka nọ. Je na Settings → Storage ma pịa Download Notes JSON iji chekwara faịlụ nkwado echekwara na koodu n'ime ngwaọrụ gị. Maka ịweghachi ya, pịa Upload Notes JSON ma họrọ faịlụ ahụ. Ihe ndetu na-anọ n'okpuru koodu n'ime faịlụ ahụ, n'ihi ya adana ya n'ụdị ọ bụla dị mma.
faq_canvas_preview_q: Me yasa zane na-egosi daban na kaadị ihe ndetu nke ndepụta?
faq_canvas_preview_a: Kaadị ihe ndetu na-egosi obere hoto nke zane gị maka sauƙaƙe aikin ngwaọrụ. Zane zuru ezu na-anọ na kariya n'oge ọ bụla — danna ndetu edita iji meghee ya na nnukwu nha mbụ. Hoto kaadị na-asabunta onwe ya n'oge ọ bụla ị dọrọ zane.
faq_biometrics_q: Yaya alamun mkpịsị aka ma ọ bụ Face ID si arụ ọrụ?
faq_biometrics_a: Bayan itinye password gị nke sirri daidai na nke mbụ, ị nwere ike sanya alamun tsaro n'okpuru Settings. N'oge imeghe ọ bụla na-esote, mkpịsị aka ma ọ bụ Face ID zai bayyana site n'onwe ya. Idan alamun tsaro arụghị ọrụ ma ọ bụ soke ya, ngwa na-alọghachi na ihu password nke sirri.
faq_reorder_checklist_q: Zan iya sake tsara ma ọ bụ lissafa abubuwan ndepụta ihe?
faq_reorder_checklist_a: Eeh. N'ime ihe ndetu ndepụta ihe, pịa akara sort na toolbar iji gbanwee n'etiti manual order, A→Z, Z→A, Ndị fọrọ afọ tupu, ma ọ bụ Ndị mecharala tupu. Ị nwere ike ịdọrọ ihe ọ bụla na handle ya iji sanya ya na daidai gurbi nke ị chọrọ — tsarin sort nke ị họrọ na-adana maka ihe ndetu ọ bụla.
faq_delete_note_q: Yaya zan goge ihe ndetu gaba ɗaya har abada?
faq_delete_note_a: Zife kaadị n'aka ekpe iji gosi zaɓin goge rubutu, ma ọ bụ jide kaadị iji banye na usoro ịhọrọ ihe dị iche iche sannan goge kaadị dị iche iche otu oge. Ihe ndetu mebiri emebi na-aga na Recycle Bin — meghee Settings → Recycle Bin iji weghachi ha ma ọ bụ goge ha gaba ɗaya.
faq_recover_note_q: Na goge bayani site na kuskure — zan iya dawo da ya?
faq_recover_note_a: Eeh. Ihe ndetu mebiri emebi anaghị apụ ozugbo — ha na-aga tupu na Recycle Bin. Meghee Settings → Recycle Bin, chọta ihe ndetu gị, ma pịa Restore iji weghachi ya. Ihe ndetu na-apụ permanente site na bin naanị mgbe ị pịrị Empty Recycle Bin, n'ihi ya ị nwere ohere dị ukwuu iji mezie kuskure.
faq_share_note_q: Yaya zan tura ihe ndetu zuru ezu nye onye ọzọ?
faq_share_note_a: Jide ihe ndetu ogologo sannan pịa akara Share iji tura ya dị ka rubutu nke yau da kullun. Ana tsara rubutun site na siffar nau'i — ihe ndepụta ihe na-enye akara ha, ihe nri na-alissafa kayan nri na laabi, usoro njem na-egosi kowane mazauni na lokaci. Maka itura bayanai dị iche iche otu oge, jide kaadị iji banye na usoro ịhọrọ ihe dị iche iche, họrọ adidir ị chọrọ, sannan pịa akara share na bar elu.
faq_change_colour_q: Yaya zan canza kalar ihe ndetu?
faq_change_colour_a: Meghee ihe ndetu ma pịa ⋮ → Gbanwee Agba iji họrọ kalar ị chọrọ (kamar Sunset, Lavender, Rose, na Forest). Kalar ị họrọ na-apụta dị ka ahịrị na kaadị ihe ndetu nke ndepụta, yadda zai kasance mfe iji gane bayanai dị iche iche na nlele anya otu ugboro. Kalar na-anọ maka ihe ndetu ọ bụla daban ma ị nwere ike ịgbanwe ya n'oge ọ bụla.
